related_questions.question: What does tax code K235 mean?
related_questions.snippet: Example: If you have a tax code of K235, you must firstly multiply the number by 10 to get the figure that affects your income, i.e. K235 = £2350. The K means that the £2350 must be added to your income to work out the tax due – if the basic rate is 20%, then you need to pay an additional £470 tax.

related_questions.question: Is 1288L better than 1257L?
related_questions.snippet: What is the difference between Tax Code 1288l vs 1257l? Employees' tax code changes to 1288L when they claim the £6 weekly working-from-home allowance. The only difference between tax code 1288L and 1257L is that you can earn up to £12,880 without paying income tax with the code 1288L.
